description: Returns one playbook's full workflow instructions, its stages, the stage reference names and the rule-kit version: the Fannie Mae AI lender letter (LL-2026-04) P&P review, or FHA, VA or USDA loan-file QC. Input: the playbook `id`; an unknown id returns `unknown_playbook` with `valid_ids`. Playbook tools accept only ids and reference names, no document text; the user's P&Ps and loan files stay in their own chat.
